editorial_review.scope: All 32 French verses reread against native Hebrew 32:2–33 by lemma and occurrence.
notes: Gen 32:1–12: grouped directional idioms, possession and prayer formulas; retained repeated Hebrew intensification.
Gen 32:13–23: reviewed gifts, distributive repetition, possession, and supplied French words as contextual.
Gen 32:24–32: grouped wrestling idioms, conditional clause, naming, and tendon expressions; supplied subjects retained as contextual.
Native Hebrew 32:1 already belongs to LSG 31:55; no duplicate source unit.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes by same editor; no independent audit or dictionary-sense verification. Publication checks deferred.
